purpose: Provisional expert benchmark for developing an Automated Student Answer Evaluation system.
important_note: These are model-generated provisional labels, NOT actual human/teacher ground truth. Replace or validate them with independent human judgments before using them for a final research claim.
score_scale: 0-10 per question; overall is the mean of Q1-Q4.

rubric.description: Technically correct statements; no substantive misconceptions.
Covers the important concepts/examples requested by the question and model answer.
Addresses the asked question without substantial irrelevant content.
Understandable, logically organized, and sufficiently precise.

question_scope.Q1: Explain data structures and their types.
question_scope.Q2: Explain an algorithm and characteristics of a good algorithm.
question_scope.Q3: Explain complexity analysis and its types.
